# Layout Structure

#### Course: Learn CSS

## Layout Structure

The design contains several styled images and texts. But before styling each card, let's only focus on the main structure.

```html
1<div class="projects-grid">
2    <!-- Fill layout with dummy items -->
3    <div></div>
4    <div></div>
5    <div></div>
6    <div></div>
7    <div></div>
8    <div></div>
9</div>
```

```css
1.projects-grid {
2    display: grid;
3
4    /* Define layout's structure */
5    grid-template-columns: 2fr 1fr 1fr;
6
7    /* Temporary row height */
8    grid-template-rows: 300px 300px;
9
10    /* Space out items */
11    gap: 20px;
12}
13
14.projects-grid > div {
15    /* Fill all items for visibility */
16    background-color: gray;
17}
```

Browser Output

![Layout Structure](data:image/png;base64,)

Here, the grid layout has six areas, with a 20px gap between each one.

We've also filled each grid area with dummy <div> elements. For better visibility, we've set the background color of each grid item to gray.

The .projects-grid > div child selector allows us to easily apply styles to all <div> elements inside the .projects-grid container.
